# Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas : An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread

Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas is a continuous digital whiteboard inside Gauth AI Course that turns any topic into a spatial, narrated visual lesson instead of a chat transcript or slide deck. Launched on October 1, 2026 through the company's launch announcement and featured on its Product Hunt launch page, it lays chapters side by side on one infinite board where notes write out in sync with AI narration and students zoom from a full concept map down to a single formula. [...] The canvas fits visual and spatial learners best: students who grasp systems faster from diagrams, timelines, and concept maps than from paragraphs. High-school and college students juggling mixed STEM workloads benefit most, since Gauth's coverage already spans algebra, calculus, physics, chemistry, and biology, and the App Store listing highlights extras like an AI Live Tutor with voice and whiteboard plus note-to-quiz converters and a study toolbox. [...] The canvas builds on Gauth's established base: an AI study companion at Gauth known for camera-based solving, step-by-step explanations, and expert help. Skywork's independent 2025 review describes a friendly balance of snap-to-solve AI, follow-up chat, and escalation to human experts. The new canvas gives that tutoring engine a visual stage.

## Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas

Launched this week

An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread

Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.
